<job>
Title: Lead generation and list building
Hello! We are looking for a lead generation specialist. We must find wholesale buyers, bulk buyers, distributors, and food market chains for our Edible Oil products in the US. Tasks will include : -Generate a list of prospects/leads - Name, email, phone - Preferably procurement managers -Verify the email list Must have good English, understand food industry terms, and be able to follow guidance to only include qualified prospects on the leads list.
</job>

text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’d be glad to help you build a qualified lead list for your Edible Oil products in the US, with a focus on wholesale buyers, bulk buyers, distributors, and food market chains.

I understand the importance of following clear criteria so the leads list only includes relevant prospects. For this project, I can help generate a structured list with name, email, phone, and role details, with priority given to procurement managers and other decision-makers where available. I also understand the need to work carefully with food industry terms and to verify email information so the final list is clean, usable, and aligned with your guidance.

My background includes extensive experience working with data and building reliable reporting systems. For example, I built a Sales KPI dashboard for Marlowe Furniture using Power BI, DAX, SQL Server, and Excel. I created one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports, which consolidated reporting and improved monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. That project reflects the kind of careful data handling, organization, and quality control I’d bring to your lead generation work.

Although my past project work has been more analytics-focused, the same skills translate well to list building: researching and organizing data, cleaning records, validating contact information, and presenting the final output in a clear, structured format. I’m comfortable working with detailed instructions and can follow your guidance closely to ensure the list is targeted and qualified.

If you’d like, I can start by building a sample batch of leads for review so we can confirm the target criteria before expanding the list further. I’d be happy to support your team in creating a strong prospect list for your edible oil outreach.
